service_name.description: The name of the service/package being configured.

shell.description: The shell type, either 'bash' or 'zsh', to set the appropriate compatibility flag.

lp_end_of_prompt.description: The character string displayed at the very end of the prompt.

lp_color.description: The color scheme for the prompt. Can be 'auto', 'dark', 'light', or 'none'.

lp_separator.description: The text or character used to separate different segments of the prompt.

lp_vcs_show_status.description: Boolean flag to enable showing Git/SVN status in the prompt.

lp_user_host_width.description: The maximum width of the user@host segment.

lp_show_pwd.description: Boolean flag to enable displaying the current working directory.

lp_vcs_branch.description: Boolean flag to enable displaying the VCS branch name.
